thesis: Docusign's confirmed fiscal Q2 2027 release showed 9% year-over-year revenue growth, IAM rising to 15.1% of ARR from 12.6% in the prior quarter, a 34% free-cash-flow margin, and higher full-year revenue and ARR guidance. Although foreign exchange contributed about 1.3 percentage points to reported growth, the broader IAM mix shift, cash generation, and raised outlook support a positive company-specific read after the 60-day advance. The bounded litigation/governance check found the principal securities matter closed and no qualifying scheduled next-90-day event or completed three-year governance failure.
invalidation: IAM's share of ARR stalls or reverses, free-cash-flow conversion materially deteriorates, or management reduces the raised fiscal 2027 revenue or ARR outlook.

thesis: Samsara's confirmed fiscal Q2 2027 release reported $508.4 million of revenue and $2.125 billion of ARR, each up 30% year over year, with GAAP operating income positive and large-enterprise ARR expanding. Although Q3 revenue growth guidance slows to about 24%, the sustained ARR growth, record large-customer additions, and operating-margin improvement support a positive company-specific read behind the 60-day move. Active patent disputes were identified, but the bounded search found no specific ruling, hearing, trial, or compliance date in the next 90 days and no qualifying completed three-year governance failure.
invalidation: ARR growth decelerates materially below the company's fiscal outlook, large-customer expansion reverses, or operating profitability turns negative without a clearly temporary cause.
sources: Samsara Q2 FY2027 results filed with the SEC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1642896/000162828026060438/samsaraepr-q22027.htm

thesis: Akamai disclosed a material seven-year Anthropic cloud agreement with approximately $11.6 billion of committed payments subject to delivery, availability, and termination terms, explaining the exceptional volume. The agreement can materially expand the cloud business, but Akamai also authorized about $1.7 billion of memory purchases and issued a performance-vesting warrant representing up to roughly 5% of common shares; those capital, customer-concentration, execution, and dilution risks keep the read low conviction despite the signed contract. The bounded litigation/governance check found no qualifying scheduled next-90-day event or completed three-year governance failure.
invalidation: Anthropic terminates or materially reduces the project plans, Akamai misses required capacity or service milestones, or the associated hardware build and warrant dilution prevent acceptable cash conversion.

thesis: Select Water Solutions signed an agreement to acquire Pilot Water Solutions for $600 million of cash, $100 million of Class A stock, and up to $15 million of contingent cash, with 480,000 barrels per day of minimum-volume commitments and 306,000 dedicated acres. The contracted infrastructure exposure supports a positive strategic read, but management's 2027 EBITDA and synergy figures remain forward estimates and the cash funding, integration burden, leverage, and stock issuance create material execution and dilution risk, so conviction is low. The bounded litigation/governance check found no qualifying scheduled next-90-day event or completed three-year governance failure.
invalidation: The transaction fails to close, minimum-volume commitments prove weaker than disclosed, pro forma leverage rises materially above management's stated plan, or integration costs overwhelm the expected economics.
sources: Select Water Solutions Pilot acquisition release: https://investors.selectwater.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/152/select-water-solutions-announces-agreement-to-acquire-pilot-water-solutions

thesis: BOXX remains an actively managed ETF designed to equal or exceed the price and yield performance of 1-3 month U.S. Treasury bills before fees by using exchange-listed box spreads. Its proximity to the 52-week high is consistent with the strategy's accrued-carry profile rather than a company-specific catalyst, so the evidence supports continuing the existing holding but only at low thesis conviction. The bounded fund/sponsor litigation and governance check found no qualifying scheduled next-90-day event or completed three-year governance failure.
invalidation: The fund changes its investment objective or box-spread implementation, develops a persistent material premium/discount or tracking impairment, or a regulatory or tax change materially alters the strategy's expected after-tax behavior.
sources: Alpha Architect ETF fund directory: https://funds.alphaarchitect.com/
